import { cpus, platform, arch } from 'node:os';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const [baseline, root, revisionsPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
const beforeSymbols = await import(pathToFileURL(baseline + '/packages/symbols/src/index.js'));
const afterSymbols = await import(pathToFileURL(root + '/packages/symbols/src/index.js'));
const beforeCil = await import(pathToFileURL(baseline + '/packages/cil/src/index.js'));
const afterCil = await import(pathToFileURL(root + '/packages/cil/src/index.js'));
const directory = root + '/tests/fixtures/portable-pdb-local-constants';
const assembly = readFileSync(directory + '/LocalConstants.dll');
const pdb = readFileSync(directory + '/LocalConstants.pdb');
const revisions = JSON.parse(readFileSync(revisionsPath, 'utf8'));
const observations = {}, loaders = { before: beforeSymbols.loadSymbols, after: afterSymbols.loadSymbols };
const readers = { before: beforeCil.readPE(assembly), after: afterCil.readPE(assembly) };
const tokens = Array.from({ length: readers.after.metadata.counts[6] }, (_, index) => 0x06000001 + index)
  .filter(token => readers.after.metadata.row(token)[0] !== 0);
const hash = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
for (const label of ['before', 'after']) {
  const symbols = loaders[label](assembly, pdb);
  const enumeration = symbols.constants.find(constant => constant.name === 'Enumeration');
  if (!symbols.bound || enumeration?.value !== -1234 || enumeration?.type !== 'short') throw Error('Load control mismatch');
  observations[label] = { constants: symbols.constants.length, enumValue: enumeration.value, enumType: enumeration.type,
    bodiesSha256: hash(JSON.stringify(tokens.map(token => readers[label].methodBody(token)))) };
}
if (JSON.stringify(observations.before) !== JSON.stringify(observations.after)) throw Error('Control results differ');
const controls = {
  load: { iterations: 100, warmups: 30, actions: { before: () => loaders.before(assembly, pdb).bound, after: () => loaders.after(assembly, pdb).bound } },
  methodBodies: { iterations: 1000, warmups: 1000, actions: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(readers).map(([label, pe]) => [label, () => {
    let length = 0;
    for (const token of tokens) length += pe.methodBody(token).code.length;
    return length;
  }])) },
};
const chronologicalSamples = [], summaries = {};
const startedAt = new Date().toISOString(), start = performance.now();
for (const [control, { iterations, warmups, actions }] of Object.entries(controls)) {
  for (let warmup = 0; warmup < warmups; warmup++) { actions.before(); actions.after(); }
  for (let pair = 0; pair < 20; pair++) {
    for (const label of pair % 2 === 0 ? ['before', 'after'] : ['after', 'before']) {
      globalThis.gc?.();
      let observed;
      const sampleStart = performance.now();
      for (let iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; iteration++) observed = actions[label]();
      const elapsedMs = performance.now() - sampleStart;
      if (!observed) throw Error('Missing benchmark result');
      chronologicalSamples.push({ control, pair, label, startOffsetMs: sampleStart - start, elapsedMs, perOperationMs: elapsedMs / iterations });
    }
  }
  summaries[control] = {};
  for (const label of ['before', 'after']) {
    const values = chronologicalSamples.filter(sample => sample.control === control && sample.label === label).map(sample => sample.perOperationMs).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    summaries[control][label] = { medianMs: (values[9] + values[10]) / 2, p95Ms: values[18] };
  }
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ revisions, node: process.version, host: `${platform()} ${arch()} ${cpus()[0].model}`,
  startedAt, protocol: { pairsPerControl: 20, loadWarmups: 30, loadsPerSample: 100, bodyWarmups: 1000, bodyBatchesPerSample: 1000,
    methodsPerBodyBatch: tokens.length, order: 'AB/BA alternating', gcBeforeEachSample: true,
    median: 'mean of positions10and11', p95: 'nearest-rank position19',
    dependencies: 'Baseline symbols and CIL sources archived at exact before revision with own workspace links; unchanged transitive archive/bytecode/framework packages resolve through current workspace.' },
  fixtures: { assemblyBytes: assembly.length, assemblySha256: hash(assembly), pdbBytes: pdb.length, pdbSha256: hash(pdb), harnessSha256: hash(readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url))) },
  observations, summaries, chronologicalSamples,
}, null, 2));
